title: AgenticVulHunter: Bringing Local Agentic Vulnerability Hunting to Your Terminal
title_zh: AgenticVulHunter：将本地智能体化漏洞挖掘带入你的终端

paragraphs.en: Finding vulnerabilities early, before they can affect the production system, is important for reducing the risk of any software attacks. However, detecting vulnerabilities during secure code review is still difficult because the vulnerable code logic may depend on lines found across different repository files. Recent approaches such as AgenticSCR have shown that LLM agents can explore repository files and use security knowledge to improve secure code review.
paragraphs.zh: 在漏洞影响生产系统之前尽早发现它们，对于降低软件攻击的风险非常重要。 然而，在安全代码审查中检测漏洞仍然很困难，因为易受攻击的代码逻辑可能依赖于分布在代码库不同文件中的多行代码。 诸如 AgenticSCR 之类的最新方法已经表明，智能体（LLM agents）能够探索代码库文件并利用安全知识来改进安全代码审查。

sents.en: Finding vulnerabilities early, before they can affect the production system, is important for reducing the risk of any software attacks.
sents.zh: 在漏洞影响生产系统之前尽早发现它们，对于降低软件攻击的风险非常重要。

sents.en: However, detecting vulnerabilities during secure code review is still difficult because the vulnerable code logic may depend on lines found across different repository files.
sents.zh: 然而，在安全代码审查中检测漏洞仍然很困难，因为易受攻击的代码逻辑可能依赖于分布在代码库不同文件中的多行代码。

sents.en: Recent approaches such as AgenticSCR have shown that LLM agents can explore repository files and use security knowledge to improve secure code review.
sents.zh: 诸如 AgenticSCR 之类的最新方法已经表明，智能体（LLM agents）能够探索代码库文件并利用安全知识来改进安全代码审查。

paragraphs.en: However, these approaches mainly rely on external commercial LLMs and can provide a large amount of security knowledge to the agent at once. This creates an important question of whether agentic secure code review can also be performed effectively using locally deployed open-weight LLMs with more focused and relevant security knowledge. In this paper, we propose AgenticVulHunter, an agentic secure code review approach and tool that can run with a locally deployed open-weight LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些方法主要依赖于外部的商用大语言模型，并且能够一次性为智能体提供大量安全知识。 这就引出了一个重要问题：能否使用本地部署的开源权重大语言模型，结合更聚焦、更相关的安全知识，同样有效地执行基于智能体的安全代码审查。 在本文中，我们提出了 AgenticVulHunter，这是一种基于智能体的安全代码审查方法与工具，可以在本地部署的开源权重大语言模型上运行。

sents.en: However, these approaches mainly rely on external commercial LLMs and can provide a large amount of security knowledge to the agent at once.
sents.zh: 然而，这些方法主要依赖于外部的商用大语言模型，并且能够一次性为智能体提供大量安全知识。

sents.en: This creates an important question of whether agentic secure code review can also be performed effectively using locally deployed open-weight LLMs with more focused and relevant security knowledge.
sents.zh: 这就引出了一个重要问题：能否使用本地部署的开源权重大语言模型，结合更聚焦、更相关的安全知识，同样有效地执行基于智能体的安全代码审查。

sents.en: In this paper, we propose AgenticVulHunter, an agentic secure code review approach and tool that can run with a locally deployed open-weight LLM.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 AgenticVulHunter，这是一种基于智能体的安全代码审查方法与工具，可以在本地部署的开源权重大语言模型上运行。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate AgenticVulHunter on 144 vulnerability cases from SCRBench using Qwen3-Coder-30B and DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus. We measure what percentage of generated review comments correctly identify the vulnerable location, match the vulnerability type, and provide a relevant security review comment together. AgenticVulHunter achieves an accuracy of 18.4% with Qwen3-Coder-30B and 23.8% with DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus, compared with 11.8% for our AgenticSCR-style reproduction using Qwen3-Coder-30B and 17.5% for AgenticSCR using Claude Sonnet 4.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SCRBench 的 144 个漏洞案例上，使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 和 DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus 对 AgenticVulHunter 进行评估。 我们衡量生成的审查评论在多大比例上能够同时正确识别漏洞位置、匹配漏洞类型并提供相关的安全审查评论。 AgenticVulHunter 在 Qwen3-Coder-30B 下达到 18.4% 的准确率，在 DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus 下达到 23.8%，相比之下，我们使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 复现的 AgenticSCR 风格方法为 11.8%，而使用 Claude Sonnet 4 的 AgenticSCR 为 17.5%。

sents.en: We evaluate AgenticVulHunter on 144 vulnerability cases from SCRBench using Qwen3-Coder-30B and DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus.
sents.zh: 我们在 SCRBench 的 144 个漏洞案例上，使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 和 DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus 对 AgenticVulHunter 进行评估。

sents.en: We measure what percentage of generated review comments correctly identify the vulnerable location, match the vulnerability type, and provide a relevant security review comment together.
sents.zh: 我们衡量生成的审查评论在多大比例上能够同时正确识别漏洞位置、匹配漏洞类型并提供相关的安全审查评论。

sents.en: AgenticVulHunter achieves an accuracy of 18.4% with Qwen3-Coder-30B and 23.8% with DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus, compared with 11.8% for our AgenticSCR-style reproduction using Qwen3-Coder-30B and 17.5% for AgenticSCR using Claude Sonnet 4.
sents.zh: AgenticVulHunter 在 Qwen3-Coder-30B 下达到 18.4% 的准确率，在 DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus 下达到 23.8%，相比之下，我们使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 复现的 AgenticSCR 风格方法为 11.8%，而使用 Claude Sonnet 4 的 AgenticSCR 为 17.5%。

paragraphs.en: Software vulnerabilities are weaknesses in software systems that can be exploited by attackers and can affect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of a system. Existing secure code review tools such as CodeQL, Semgrep, and Snyk can analyse source code and report possible vulnerabilities. More recently, AgenticSCR [ 1 ] showed that LLM agents can explore repository files and use CWE and SAST knowledge to reason about vulnerabilities. Although this improves secure code review capabilities, several challenges still remain.
paragraphs.zh: 软件漏洞是软件系统中的弱点，攻击者可以利用这些弱点，并可能影响系统的机密性、完整性和可用性。 现有的安全代码审查工具，如 CodeQL、Semgrep 和 Snyk，可以分析源代码并报告可能的漏洞。 最近，AgenticSCR [ 1 ] 表明，大语言模型智能体可以探索仓库文件，并利用 CWE 和 SAST 知识对漏洞进行推理。 尽管这提升了安全代码审查的能力，但仍存在若干挑战。

sents.en: Software vulnerabilities are weaknesses in software systems that can be exploited by attackers and can affect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of a system.
sents.zh: 软件漏洞是软件系统中的弱点，攻击者可以利用这些弱点，并可能影响系统的机密性、完整性和可用性。

sents.en: Existing secure code review tools such as CodeQL, Semgrep, and Snyk can analyse source code and report possible vulnerabilities.
sents.zh: 现有的安全代码审查工具，如 CodeQL、Semgrep 和 Snyk，可以分析源代码并报告可能的漏洞。

sents.en: More recently, AgenticSCR [ 1 ] showed that LLM agents can explore repository files and use CWE and SAST knowledge to reason about vulnerabilities.
sents.zh: 最近，AgenticSCR [ 1 ] 表明，大语言模型智能体可以探索仓库文件，并利用 CWE 和 SAST 知识对漏洞进行推理。

sents.en: Although this improves secure code review capabilities, several challenges still remain.
sents.zh: 尽管这提升了安全代码审查的能力，但仍存在若干挑战。

paragraphs.en: First, providing a large amount of security knowledge can introduce noise, making it harder to focus on the most relevant vulnerability knowledge. AgenticSCR is designed to augment domain-specific security knowledge by incorporating a large amount of Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and Static Application Security Testing (SAST) knowledge into the agentic memory. However, not all of this knowledge is useful or relevant to every pull request. Recently, Yang et al. [ 2 ] found that useful program context can improve vulnerability detection, while excessive context can make it harder for the model to focus on relevant information.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，提供大量安全知识会引入噪声，使智能体更难聚焦于最相关的漏洞知识。 AgenticSCR 旨在增强领域特定的安全知识，具体做法是将大量通用缺陷枚举（CWE）和静态应用安全测试（SAST）知识纳入智能体记忆中。 然而，并非所有这些知识对每个拉取请求都有用或相关。最近，Yang 等人 [ 2 ] 发现有用的程序上下文可以改进漏洞检测，而过多的上下文会使模型更难聚焦于相关信息。

sents.en: First, providing a large amount of security knowledge can introduce noise, making it harder to focus on the most relevant vulnerability knowledge.
sents.zh: 首先，提供大量安全知识会引入噪声，使智能体更难聚焦于最相关的漏洞知识。

sents.en: AgenticSCR is designed to augment domain-specific security knowledge by incorporating a large amount of Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and Static Application Security Testing (SAST) knowledge into the agentic memory.
sents.zh: AgenticSCR 旨在增强领域特定的安全知识，具体做法是将大量通用缺陷枚举（CWE）和静态应用安全测试（SAST）知识纳入智能体记忆中。

sents.en: However, not all of this knowledge is useful or relevant to every pull request. Recently, Yang et al.
sents.zh: 然而，并非所有这些知识对每个拉取请求都有用或相关。最近，Yang 等人

sents.en: [ 2 ] found that useful program context can improve vulnerability detection, while excessive context can make it harder for the model to focus on relevant information.
sents.zh: [ 2 ] 发现有用的程序上下文可以改进漏洞检测，而过多的上下文会使模型更难聚焦于相关信息。

paragraphs.en: Second, commercial LLMs may not be suitable for enterprise environments where source code cannot be shared externally. AgenticSCR is designed for commercial large language models (LLMs), such as Claude, which may limit the applicability of such tools in the enterprise context. In enterprise environments, source code is confidential and cannot be sent to an externally hosted commercial model. Thus, little is known about the performance of agentic secure code review on the open-weight language models.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，商业大语言模型可能不适用于源代码不能外传的企业环境。 AgenticSCR 是为商业大语言模型（LLM）设计的，例如 Claude，这可能限制了此类工具在企业场景中的适用性。 在企业环境中，源代码是机密的，不能发送到外部托管的商业模型。 因此，目前对智能体安全代码评审在开源权重语言模型上的性能知之甚少。

sents.en: Second, commercial LLMs may not be suitable for enterprise environments where source code cannot be shared externally.
sents.zh: 其次，商业大语言模型可能不适用于源代码不能外传的企业环境。

sents.en: AgenticSCR is designed for commercial large language models (LLMs), such as Claude, which may limit the applicability of such tools in the enterprise context.
sents.zh: AgenticSCR 是为商业大语言模型（LLM）设计的，例如 Claude，这可能限制了此类工具在企业场景中的适用性。

sents.en: In enterprise environments, source code is confidential and cannot be sent to an externally hosted commercial model.
sents.zh: 在企业环境中，源代码是机密的，不能发送到外部托管的商业模型。

sents.en: Thus, little is known about the performance of agentic secure code review on the open-weight language models.
sents.zh: 因此，目前对智能体安全代码评审在开源权重语言模型上的性能知之甚少。

paragraphs.en: Third, there is a lack of practical agentic secure code review tools that developers can use before creating a pull request. AgenticSCR shows the potential of using agents for secure code review, but it is mainly presented as a research approach rather than a tool that developers can install and use. Existing tools such as CodeQL, Semgrep, and Snyk Code can detect possible security issues [ 3 ] . However, these tools mainly rely on static analysis rather than allowing an agent to explore relevant repository files.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，缺乏实用的智能体化安全代码审查工具，供开发者在创建拉取请求之前使用。 AgenticSCR 展示了使用智能体进行安全代码审查的潜力，但它主要是作为一种研究方法提出，而非开发者可以安装使用的工具。 现有工具如 CodeQL、Semgrep 和 Snyk Code 可以检测可能存在的安全问题 [ 3 ] 。 然而，这些工具主要依赖静态分析，而不是让智能体去探索相关的仓库文件。

sents.en: Third, there is a lack of practical agentic secure code review tools that developers can use before creating a pull request.
sents.zh: 第三，缺乏实用的智能体化安全代码审查工具，供开发者在创建拉取请求之前使用。

sents.en: AgenticSCR shows the potential of using agents for secure code review, but it is mainly presented as a research approach rather than a tool that developers can install and use.
sents.zh: AgenticSCR 展示了使用智能体进行安全代码审查的潜力，但它主要是作为一种研究方法提出，而非开发者可以安装使用的工具。

sents.en: Existing tools such as CodeQL, Semgrep, and Snyk Code can detect possible security issues [ 3 ] .
sents.zh: 现有工具如 CodeQL、Semgrep 和 Snyk Code 可以检测可能存在的安全问题 [ 3 ] 。

sents.en: However, these tools mainly rely on static analysis rather than allowing an agent to explore relevant repository files.
sents.zh: 然而，这些工具主要依赖静态分析，而不是让智能体去探索相关的仓库文件。

paragraphs.en: To address the above challenges, AgenticVulHunter is designed around three main ideas. First, instead of giving all CWE and SAST knowledge to the model at once, AgenticVulHunter uses security knowledge search. It uses keywords from the collected repository knowledge to search for the closest matching CWE, and changes the search keywords for a better search result. Second, AgenticVulHunter supports locally deployed open-weight LLMs, so when a local model is used, the source code does not need to be sent to an external LLM provider. Third, similar to previous research on terminal-based agentic code review [ 4 ] , AgenticVulHunter provides a practical tool that allows developers to detect potential vulnerabilities directly from the terminal before creating a pull request.
paragraphs.zh: 为了应对上述挑战，AgenticVulHunter 围绕三个主要思路进行设计。 首先，AgenticVulHunter 不一次性向模型提供所有 CWE 和 SAST 知识，而是使用安全知识搜索。 它利用收集到的仓库知识中的关键词搜索最匹配的 CWE，并调整搜索关键词以获得更好的搜索结果。 其次，AgenticVulHunter 支持本地部署的开源权重 LLM，因此当使用本地模型时，源代码无需发送给外部 LLM 提供商。 第三，与以往基于终端的智能体代码审查研究 [ 4 ] 类似，AgenticVulHunter 提供了一个实用工具，使开发者能够在创建拉取请求之前直接从终端检测潜在漏洞。

sents.en: To address the above challenges, AgenticVulHunter is designed around three main ideas.
sents.zh: 为了应对上述挑战，AgenticVulHunter 围绕三个主要思路进行设计。

sents.en: First, instead of giving all CWE and SAST knowledge to the model at once, AgenticVulHunter uses security knowledge search.
sents.zh: 首先，AgenticVulHunter 不一次性向模型提供所有 CWE 和 SAST 知识，而是使用安全知识搜索。

sents.en: It uses keywords from the collected repository knowledge to search for the closest matching CWE, and changes the search keywords for a better search result.
sents.zh: 它利用收集到的仓库知识中的关键词搜索最匹配的 CWE，并调整搜索关键词以获得更好的搜索结果。

sents.en: Second, AgenticVulHunter supports locally deployed open-weight LLMs, so when a local model is used, the source code does not need to be sent to an external LLM provider.
sents.zh: 其次，AgenticVulHunter 支持本地部署的开源权重 LLM，因此当使用本地模型时，源代码无需发送给外部 LLM 提供商。

sents.en: Third, similar to previous research on terminal-based agentic code review [ 4 ] , AgenticVulHunter provides a practical tool that allows developers to detect potential vulnerabilities directly from the terminal before creating a pull request.
sents.zh: 第三，与以往基于终端的智能体代码审查研究 [ 4 ] 类似，AgenticVulHunter 提供了一个实用工具，使开发者能够在创建拉取请求之前直接从终端检测潜在漏洞。

paragraphs.en: The developer first installs the tool using ( $ pipx install agenticvulhunter ), then initializes AgenticVulHunter for their working project using ( $ agenticvulhunter init ), and starts the secure code review using ( $ agenticvulhunter review ). The review checks the code diff between the latest commit and the previous commit and analyses the lines that were added or changed. Figure 1 shows the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 开发者首先使用（ $ pipx install agenticvulhunter ）安装该工具，然后使用（ $ agenticvulhunter init ）为其工作项目初始化 AgenticVulHunter，并使用（ $ agenticvulhunter review ）启动安全代码审查。 该审查会检查最新一次提交与前一次提交之间的代码差异，并分析新增或修改的行。 图 1 展示了最终结果。

sents.en: The developer first installs the tool using ( $ pipx install agenticvulhunter ), then initializes AgenticVulHunter for their working project using ( $ agenticvulhunter init ), and starts the secure code review using ( $ agenticvulhunter review ).
sents.zh: 开发者首先使用（ $ pipx install agenticvulhunter ）安装该工具，然后使用（ $ agenticvulhunter init ）为其工作项目初始化 AgenticVulHunter，并使用（ $ agenticvulhunter review ）启动安全代码审查。

sents.en: The review checks the code diff between the latest commit and the previous commit and analyses the lines that were added or changed.
sents.zh: 该审查会检查最新一次提交与前一次提交之间的代码差异，并分析新增或修改的行。

sents.en: Figure 1 shows the final result.
sents.zh: 图 1 展示了最终结果。

paragraphs.en: CWE Type: the identified CWE type for the vulnerability. Localized Line: the file and line number where the vulnerability is found. Vulnerable Code: the code snippet related to the vulnerability. Review: the generated secure code review comment explaining the issue and how it can be fixed.
paragraphs.zh: CWE 类型：该漏洞所识别出的 CWE 类型。 定位行：发现漏洞的文件及行号。 漏洞代码：与该漏洞相关的代码片段。 审查：生成的安全代码审查意见，用于说明该问题及其修复方法。

sents.en: CWE Type: the identified CWE type for the vulnerability.
sents.zh: CWE 类型：该漏洞所识别出的 CWE 类型。

sents.en: Localized Line: the file and line number where the vulnerability is found.
sents.zh: 定位行：发现漏洞的文件及行号。

sents.en: Vulnerable Code: the code snippet related to the vulnerability.
sents.zh: 漏洞代码：与该漏洞相关的代码片段。

sents.en: Review: the generated secure code review comment explaining the issue and how it can be fixed.
sents.zh: 审查：生成的安全代码审查意见，用于说明该问题及其修复方法。

paragraphs.en: AgenticVulHunter analyses the changed code through four main stages as shown in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: AgenticVulHunter 通过如图 2 所示的四个主要阶段来分析变更的代码。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 (Fig. 2 ) analyses the Git diff, which contains the lines of code added or changed between the latest commit and the previous commit. The agent identifies changed lines that may be security-sensitive or potentially vulnerable and selects them as vulnerability candidates. The agent also has access to the repository and can explore relevant files to gather additional context when needed.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1（图 2）分析 Git diff，其中包含最新提交与上一次提交之间新增或修改的代码行。 智能体识别可能涉及安全敏感或存在潜在漏洞的变更代码行，并将其选为漏洞候选。 智能体还可以访问代码仓库，并在需要时浏览相关文件以获取更多上下文信息。

sents.en: Stage 1 (Fig. 2 ) analyses the Git diff, which contains the lines of code added or changed between the latest commit and the previous commit.
sents.zh: 阶段 1（图 2）分析 Git diff，其中包含最新提交与上一次提交之间新增或修改的代码行。

sents.en: The agent identifies changed lines that may be security-sensitive or potentially vulnerable and selects them as vulnerability candidates.
sents.zh: 智能体识别可能涉及安全敏感或存在潜在漏洞的变更代码行，并将其选为漏洞候选。

sents.en: The agent also has access to the repository and can explore relevant files to gather additional context when needed.
sents.zh: 智能体还可以访问代码仓库，并在需要时浏览相关文件以获取更多上下文信息。

paragraphs.en: Selection Reason: Why the candidate was selected as a potentially vulnerable line.
paragraphs.zh: 选择原因：该候选者为何被选为潜在易受攻击的代码行。

paragraphs.en: Confidence Score: The model’s confidence that the selected line may be vulnerable.
paragraphs.zh: 置信度分数：模型对所选行可能存在漏洞的置信程度。

paragraphs.en: Context Lines: The 15 lines before and after the selected line, which are used as the starting context for Stage 2.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文行：所选行之前和之后的 15 行，作为第二阶段的起始上下文。

paragraphs.en: This information also helps the validator understand why the candidate was selected.
paragraphs.zh: 这些信息还有助于验证者理解为什么该候选被选中。

sents.zh: 一个潜在易受攻击的候选行的行为可能取决于代码库其他部分中找到的代码。

paragraphs.en: Function Name: The function or method where the vulnerability candidate line is located.
paragraphs.zh: 函数名：疑似漏洞代码行所在的函数或方法。

paragraphs.en: Operation Type: The type of operation being performed, e.g. SQL query.
paragraphs.zh: 操作类型：正在执行的操作的类型，例如 SQL 查询。

paragraphs.en: Variable Source: Where the important variables linked to the possible vulnerability come from.
paragraphs.zh: 变量来源：与可能漏洞相关的重要变量来自何处。

paragraphs.en: Vulnerability Reach: The security-sensitive operation that the candidate may reach.
paragraphs.zh: 漏洞影响范围：候选智能体可能触达的安全敏感操作。

paragraphs.en: Security Check: Whether any important security check or validation is missing for the candidate line.
paragraphs.zh: 安全检查：针对候选行是否缺少任何重要的安全检查或验证。

paragraphs.en: Overall Summary: A summary of the candidate and how it behaves.
paragraphs.zh: 总体摘要：对候选内容及其行为方式的摘要。

paragraphs.en: This collected information forms the security knowledge base for each candidate and is passed to the later stages.
paragraphs.zh: 收集到的这些信息构成了每个候选人的安全知识库，并传递给后续阶段。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3 (Fig. 2 ), uses the security knowledge base to search for possible vulnerability types. Based on this knowledge, the agent creates a keyword query for the BM25-based CWE retriever [ 5 ] . The retriever searches the CWE knowledge base and returns the most relevant CWEs for the candidate line. The agent then checks whether the retrieved CWE information matches the behaviour of the candidate.

paragraphs.en: For answering our research question, we use the SCRBench dataset for the experimental setup and evaluation [ 1 ] . SCRBench is designed for pre-commit secure code review and contains 144 vulnerability cases. Following the AgenticSCR setup, GPT-4.1 is used as the judge for fair comparison.

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How effectively does AgenticVulHunter perform when compared to the state-of-the-art Agentic AI for secure code review (AgenticSCR)?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：与最先进的安全代码审查智能体（AgenticSCR）相比，AgenticVulHunter 的表现如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: What is the impact of the validation threshold on the performance of AgenticVulHunter?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：验证阈值对 AgenticVulHunter 的性能有什么影响？

paragraphs.en: To answer each research question, we use the following SCRBench measures [ 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答每个研究问题，我们使用以下 SCRBench 度量指标 [ 1 ]。

paragraphs.en: Location Match (L): Percentage of comments in the same file and within ± 5 \pm 5 lines of the ground-truth vulnerable line.
paragraphs.zh: 位置匹配（L）：在同一定位文件中、且位于真实漏洞行 ± 5 \pm 5 行范围内的评论所占的百分比。

paragraphs.en: Comment Type Match (T): Percentage of comments whose predicted CWE belongs to the same family-level CWE category as the ground-truth vulnerability.
paragraphs.zh: 评论类型匹配（T）：预测的 CWE 属于与真实漏洞相同的族级 CWE 类别的评论所占的百分比。

paragraphs.en: Comment Relevance (R): Percentage of comments whose CWE explanation correctly describes the ground-truth vulnerability.
paragraphs.zh: 评论相关性（R）：其 CWE 解释正确描述真实漏洞的评论所占的百分比。

paragraphs.en: Overall Correctness (L&R&T): Percentage of comments that simultaneously satisfy Location Match, Comment Relevance, and Comment Type Match.
paragraphs.zh: 总体正确性（L&R&T）：同时满足位置匹配（Location Match）、评论相关性（Comment Relevance）和评论类型匹配（Comment Type Match）的评论所占的百分比。

paragraphs.en: To establish a fair comparison with the prior study, we compare the performance of AgenticVulHunter with our AgenticSCR-style reproduction using Qwen3-Coder-30B, the published AgenticSCR result using Claude Sonnet 4, Static LLM, CodeQL, Semgrep, and Snyk.
paragraphs.zh: 为了与先前的研究建立公平的比较，我们将 AgenticVulHunter 的性能与我们使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 的 AgenticSCR 风格复现、已发表的基于 Claude Sonnet 4 的 AgenticSCR 结果、Static LLM、CodeQL、Semgrep 和 Snyk 进行比较。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present the results of AgenticVulHunter for the proposed research questions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们针对所提出的研究问题展示 AgenticVulHunter 的结果。

paragraphs.en: Approach. To analyse RQ1, we evaluate AgenticVulHunter from three perspectives. First, we compare AgenticVulHunter with our AgenticSCR-style reproduction using the same Qwen3-Coder-30B model to compare performance under the same language model. Second, we compare AgenticVulHunter with static analysis baselines, including CodeQL, Semgrep, and Snyk. Third, we evaluate AgenticVulHunter with DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus to examine whether the approach remains effective with another open-weight language model.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 为分析 RQ1，我们从三个角度评估 AgenticVulHunter。 首先，我们将 AgenticVulHunter 与使用相同 Qwen3-Coder-30B 模型的 AgenticSCR 风格复现版本进行比较，以便在相同语言模型下比较性能。 其次，我们将 AgenticVulHunter 与静态分析基线进行比较，包括 CodeQL、Semgrep 和 Snyk。 第三，我们使用 DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus 评估 AgenticVulHunter，以检验该方法在另一个开放权重语言模型上是否仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: Finding 1: AgenticVulHunter with targeted security knowledge retrieval outperforms the AgenticSCR-style reproduction using the same model. The current state-of-the-art approach, AgenticSCR, populates the LLM memory with a large amount of CWE and SAST knowledge. This contains approximately 38,615 lines of security knowledge, including 28,888 lines of CWE knowledge covering 944 CWE entries and 9,727 lines of SAST rules. In contrast, AgenticVulHunter starts from the changed line and builds security knowledge about the vulnerability candidate through agentically exploring relevant repository files. This collected knowledge is then used to search for CWE information relevant to the current vulnerability candidate line. This is designed to provide more relevant information for reasoning without overwhelming smaller models with excessive security knowledge. As shown in Table I , AgenticVulHunter achieves an L&R&T score of 18.4% with Qwen3-Coder-30B, compared with 11.8% for the AgenticSCR-style reproduction using the same model, representing an improvement of 6.6 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: 发现1：结合针对性安全知识检索的 AgenticVulHunter 优于使用相同模型的 AgenticSCR 风格复现。 当前最先进的方法 AgenticSCR 在大语言模型记忆中填充了大量 CWE 和 SAST 知识。 其中包含约 38,615 行安全知识，包括覆盖 944 个 CWE 条目的 28,888 行 CWE 知识，以及 9,727 行 SAST 规则。 相比之下，AgenticVulHunter 从变更行出发，通过智能体式地探索相关仓库文件来构建关于漏洞候选的安全知识。 随后，所收集的知识被用于搜索与当前漏洞候选行相关的 CWE 信息。 这一设计旨在为推理提供更相关的信息，同时避免过量的安全知识压垮较小的模型。 如表 I 所示，AgenticVulHunter 使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 取得了 18.4% 的 L&R&T 分数，而使用相同模型的 AgenticSCR 风格复现仅为 11.8%，提升了 6.6 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Finding 2: AgenticVulHunter outperforms the static analysis baselines. Current static analysis tools such as CodeQL, Semgrep, and Snyk rely mainly on predefined rules and analysis patterns to identify possible vulnerabilities. In contrast, AgenticVulHunter allows the agent to explore relevant files and collect additional context before generating the review. Table I shows that AgenticVulHunter achieves an L&R&T score of 18.4%, compared with 0.6% for CodeQL, 3.7% for Semgrep, and 0.9% for Snyk.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 2：AgenticVulHunter 优于静态分析基线。 目前的静态分析工具（如 CodeQL、Semgrep 和 Snyk）主要依赖预定义的规则和分析模式来识别可能的漏洞。 相比之下，AgenticVulHunter 允许智能体在生成审查之前探索相关文件并收集更多上下文。 表 I 显示，AgenticVulHunter 的 L&R&T 得分为 18.4%，而 CodeQL 为 0.6%，Semgrep 为 3.7%，Snyk 为 0.9%。

paragraphs.en: Finding 3: AgenticVulHunter is effective with another open-weight language model. To examine whether the approach remains effective beyond Qwen3-Coder-30B, we evaluate AgenticVulHunter using DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus. As shown in Table I , AgenticVulHunter achieves an L&R&T score of 23.8% with DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus, compared with 18.4% using Qwen3-Coder-30B. The DeepSeek result is also higher than the 17.5% reported by AgenticSCR using Claude Sonnet 4. This shows that the overall AgenticVulHunter approach remains effective when used with a different open-weight language model and is not dependent on Qwen3-Coder-30B alone.
paragraphs.zh: 发现3：AgenticVulHunter 在另一个开放权重语言模型上同样有效。 为了检验该方法在 Qwen3-Coder-30B 之外是否仍然有效，我们使用 DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus 对 AgenticVulHunter 进行了评估。 如表 I 所示，AgenticVulHunter 使用 DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus 时取得了 23.8% 的 L&R&T 分数，而使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 时为 18.4%。 DeepSeek 的结果也高于 AgenticSCR 使用 Claude Sonnet 4 报告的 17.5%。 这表明 AgenticVulHunter 的整体方法在搭配不同开放权重语言模型时仍然有效，并且不仅依赖于 Qwen3-Coder-30B。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, these findings together answer RQ1 by showing that AgenticVulHunter performs better than the AgenticSCR-style reproduction when using the same Qwen3-Coder-30B model, substantially outperforms the static analysis baselines, and remains effective when applied with another open-weight language model.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这些发现共同回答了 RQ1，表明在使用相同的 Qwen3-Coder-30B 模型时，AgenticVulHunter 的表现优于 AgenticSCR 式复现，大幅超越静态分析基线，并且在应用另一个开源权重语言模型时依然保持有效。

paragraphs.en: Finding 4: Increasing the validation threshold generally improves the L&R&T score by filtering weaker vulnerability line candidate reviews. As shown in Fig. 3 , For AgenticVulHunter using Qwen3-Coder-30B, the L&R&T score increases from 17.4% at t = 0.0 t=0.0 to its highest value of 27.6% at t = 0.9 t=0.9 . This behaviour is supported by the scoring mechanism used in AgenticVulHunter. In Stage 4, the model uses the evidence collected from previous stages to score each vulnerability line candidate between 0 and 1 across five validation categories (exact CWE fit, security protection failure, vulnerability connection from the source of the variable to its reach, diff causality caused by the changed line, and security impact). At lower thresholds, reviews with weaker or incomplete evidence can still pass Stage 4. As the threshold increases, a review needs stronger and more consistent evidence across all validation categories to remain. As a result, higher thresholds retain a larger proportion of reviews that are correct in location, vulnerability type, and relevance together.
paragraphs.zh: 发现4：提高验证阈值通常可以通过过滤较弱的漏洞行候选评审来提升 L&R&T 得分。 如图 3 所示，对于使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 的 AgenticVulHunter，L&R&T 得分从 t = 0.0 t=0.0 时的 17.4% 上升到 t = 0.9 t=0.9 时的最高值 27.6%。 这一行为得到了 AgenticVulHunter 所用评分机制的支持。 在阶段 4 中，模型利用先前阶段收集的证据，在五个验证类别（精确 CWE 匹配、安全防护失效、从变量来源到其可达位置的漏洞关联、由变更行导致的 diff 因果性、以及安全影响）方面为每个漏洞行候选打 0 到 1 之间的分数。 在较低阈值下，证据较弱或不完整的评审仍能通过阶段 4。 随着阈值提高，评审需要在所有验证类别上拥有更强且更一致的证据才能保留下来。 因此，较高的阈值会保留更大比例在位置、漏洞类型和相关性上都正确的评审。

sents.zh: 如图 3 所示，对于使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 的 AgenticVulHunter，L&R&T 得分从 t = 0.0 t=0.0 时的 17.4% 上升到 t = 0.9 t=0.9 时的最高值 27.6%。

sents.en: This behaviour is supported by the scoring mechanism used in AgenticVulHunter.
sents.zh: 这一行为得到了 AgenticVulHunter 所用评分机制的支持。

sents.en: In Stage 4, the model uses the evidence collected from previous stages to score each vulnerability line candidate between 0 and 1 across five validation categories (exact CWE fit, security protection failure, vulnerability connection from the source of the variable to its reach, diff causality caused by the changed line, and security impact).
sents.zh: 在阶段 4 中，模型利用先前阶段收集的证据，在五个验证类别（精确 CWE 匹配、安全防护失效、从变量来源到其可达位置的漏洞关联、由变更行导致的 diff 因果性、以及安全影响）方面为每个漏洞行候选打 0 到 1 之间的分数。

sents.en: At lower thresholds, reviews with weaker or incomplete evidence can still pass Stage 4.
sents.zh: 在较低阈值下，证据较弱或不完整的评审仍能通过阶段 4。

sents.en: As the threshold increases, a review needs stronger and more consistent evidence across all validation categories to remain.

paragraphs.en: Finding 5: AgenticVulHunter remains competitive across all tested validation thresholds. As shown in Fig. 3 , Across all tested thresholds from t = 0.0 t=0.0 to t = 1.0 t=1.0 , AgenticVulHunter remains above the 11.8% AgenticSCR Qwen3-Coder-30B baseline. From t = 0.4 t=0.4 onward, the L&R&T score is also competitive or higher than the 17.5% reported by AgenticSCR using Claude Sonnet 4.
paragraphs.zh: 发现5：AgenticVulHunter 在所有测试的验证阈值下均保持竞争力。 如图3所示，在从 t = 0.0 t=0.0 到 t = 1.0 t=1.0 的所有测试阈值下，AgenticVulHunter 始终高于 11.8% 的 AgenticSCR Qwen3-Coder-30B 基线。 从 t = 0.4 t=0.4 起，L&R&T 得分也与 AgenticSCR 使用 Claude Sonnet 4 报告的 17.5% 相当或更高。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, these findings together answer RQ2 by showing that increasing the validation threshold generally improves the L&R&T performance of AgenticVulHunter by filtering weaker reviews, while the performance remains higher than the 11.8% AgenticSCR Qwen3-Coder-30B baseline across all tested thresholds.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这些发现共同回答了 RQ2：提高验证阈值通常会通过过滤较弱的评审来提升 AgenticVulHunter 的 L&R&T 性能，同时在所有测试阈值下，其性能均保持高于 11.8% 的 AgenticSCR Qwen3-Coder-30B 基线。

AgenticVulHunter remains higher than the AgenticSCR Qwen3-Coder-30B baseline across all tested thresholds, and from t = 0.4 t=0.4 onward performs at least on par with or higher than the 17.5% reported by AgenticSCR using Claude Sonnet 4.

However, LLM judges may produce different results across runs. To reduce this threat, we use the same evaluation settings as SCRBench and AgenticSCR, including a temperature of 0.
paragraphs.zh: 构建效度。 为进行公平比较，我们遵循 AgenticSCR，使用 GPT-4.1 作为 LLM 即评审（LLM-as-a-Judge）来评估生成的评审意见的正确性。 然而，LLM 评审在多次运行中可能产生不同的结果。 为减少这一威胁，我们采用与 SCRBench 和 AgenticSCR 相同的评估设置，包括将温度设为 0。

paragraphs.en: AgenticVulHunter is developed to investigate whether pre-commit agentic secure code review can work effectively with locally deployed open-weight language models. Our results show that this approach improves secure code review performance with open-weight language models. Using Qwen3-Coder-30B, AgenticVulHunter achieves an L&R&T score of 18.4%, compared with 11.8% for the AgenticSCR using the same model. These results show that locally deployable open-weight language models can support effective agentic secure code review when they are provided with relevant and focused security knowledge. To support the reproducibility of our work, the tool and the replication package is publicly-available at https://github.com/awsm-research/AgenticVulHunter/ .
paragraphs.zh: AgenticVulHunter 旨在研究提交前的智能体安全代码审查能否与本地部署的开源权重语言模型有效协同工作。 我们的结果表明，该方法能够提升开源权重语言模型的安全代码审查性能。 使用 Qwen3-Coder-30B 时，AgenticVulHunter 的 L&R&T 得分为 18.4%，而使用同一模型的 AgenticSCR 得分为 11.8%。 这些结果表明，只要为本地可部署的开源权重语言模型提供相关且聚焦的安全知识，它们就能支持有效的智能体安全代码审查。 为支持本工作的可复现性，该工具与复现包已在 https://github.com/awsm-research/AgenticVulHunter/ 公开发布。
